A_eval.name: A_eval
A_eval.description: Evaluation-awareness, Heidari et al.'s contrastive framing ported to the agentic setting. Tool outputs are the REAL ones in both members of the pair.

C_declared.name: C_declared
C_declared.description: Declared environment-realness: the same construction as A, on the realness axis. Tool outputs are the REAL ones in both members of the pair.

B_empirical.name: B_empirical
B_empirical.description: Empirical environment-realness: no framing sentence; the tool outputs themselves are genuine or LLM-fabricated. Available only because a REAL arm exists.

S_scripted.name: S_scripted
S_scripted.description: Transfer control for B: fabrication by template rather than by a model. Separates 'detects synthetic environments' from 'detects one simulator's prose'.

A_chat.name: A_chat
A_chat.description: Evaluation-awareness on short chat prompts, in the original style. Checks that the agentic port of A behaves like the construction it ports.

verdict.statement:
exp0 VERDICT: SEPARABLE.
  cross-AUROC A->B = 0.605, B->A = 0.579; at least one < 0.85.
  Environment-realness is not reducible to evaluation-awareness in this model.
  P5' is SUPPORTED at this scale. The project proceeds.
